calls.title: EQT<>GrowthBook - Experimentation Best Practices
calls.summary: Eric Schillstroem (EQT consultant) discussed the need for a simple A/B testing capability using GrowthBook to demonstrate value to a slow-moving, compliance-heavy private equity firm, focusing on upper-funnel engagement metrics rather than conversions. Key participants included Eric, Jake Heier (GrowthBook sales), Cris Dizon (customer success), and Jeremy (GrowthBook). Next steps: GrowthBook will provide three simple test ideas (e.g., an AA test or removing a hero banner), and Jake will follow up via Slack to finalize the implementation plan.
